children: Genvor secured short-term financing through two insider promissory notes totaling $30,000, each carrying a 2% original issue discount and 15% annual interest. The company issued notes on Oct 16, 2026 to Dr. Jesse Jaynes and Dr. Clayton Yates following their respective fundings on Oct 8, 2026. The Jaynes note has an original principal of $20,408.16 and the Yates note $10,204.08, with both maturing on Apr 8, 2027. Neither note is convertible into equity, providing straightforward, near-term liquidity from directors.
